# Beyond®

> Creative Growth Agency — "Tomorrow's brands, today."™
> Domain: beyondbasics.studio
> Contact: hello@beyondbasics.studio
> New business: hello@beyondbasics.studio
> Careers: jobs@beyondbasics.studio
> Press: press@beyondbasics.studio

Beyond is a creative growth agency that partners with ambitious companies to transform them into category leaders. We combine brand strategy, identity design, web design & development, motion, 3D, and WebGL into end-to-end engagements. Our work has earned 50+ Awwwards, FWA, and CSS Design Awards.

---

## Services

### Retainer — Embedded Creative Partner
An ongoing partnership. Beyond becomes an embedded extension of your team, covering brand evolution, campaign work, product design, and continuous digital execution. Ideal for high-growth companies that need consistent, senior-level creative output without building an in-house team.

### Project — Focused Transformation
A scoped engagement with clear deliverables and timelines. Ideal for rebrands, website launches, campaign sprints, or product redesigns. We define the objective, assemble the right team, and execute with full accountability.

**Service capabilities:**
- Brand Strategy
- Brand Identity & Visual Systems
- Web Design & Development
- Motion Design & Animation
- 3D Visualization & WebGL
- UI/UX Design
- Design Systems
- Art Direction
- Photography & Video Direction
- Sound Design
- E-commerce UX
- CRM Integration

## Selected Work (17 Projects)

### Clear Street — Rebranding & Website (2024)
Tagline: "Designed for the Future."
A fintech website for capital markets infrastructure. Features a WebGL-rendered globe, animated pictograms inspired by airline visuals, and an iconic RGB Klein blue palette. Sets the benchmark for fintech design.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day, Developer Award · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · FWA of the Day
Website: clearstreet.io
URL: /work/clear-street

### Remote — Website (2024)
Tagline: "Stress-free global hiring."
Rich 3D globes built entirely in-browser with WebGL, expressive illustrations, and photography masked by eight distinct key shapes. The globes react dynamically as users scroll.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day, Honorable Mention · CSS Design Awards Special Kudos
Website: remote.com
URL: /work/remote

### MultiversX — Naming, Rebranding & Website (2022)
Tagline: "Scale across the Multiverse."
Naming journey from brainstorming sessions to "Multivers elevated to the power of X." Three-font typography system, vibrant sub-brand colour palette, fully scalable design system spanning product UI, social, and keynote.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day, Developer Award · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · FWA of the Day
Website: multiversx.com
URL: /work/multiversx

### Phive — Rebrand & Website (2025)
Tagline: "Activate your senses."
Typographic-first fitness club brand with variable typeface, custom video, bold timelapses, and 40-second visual punches per location. One of our sharpest builds.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day
Website: phive.pt
URL: /work/phive

### Floema — Rebrand & Website (2026)
Tagline: "Made for Life."
230 web-optimised 3D product models with CRM integration, WebGL foliage, field recordings, and a header that evolves from snow to full greenery across seasons. Five product collections: Urban, Golf, rePlastic, Nature, Details.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · FWA of the Day
Website: floema.com
URL: /work/floema

### TUU — Rebrand (2026)
Tagline: "Shaping Everyday Life."
A variable identity system — the logo is never fixed, always anchored to edges, morphing into new configurations. Motion system across three compositional modes. Typography at core, motion as force.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention · CSS Design Awards Special Kudos
URL: /work/tuu

### Redacted RnD — Brand Identity (2026)
Tagline: "Hidden in plain sight."
Visual language inspired by redacted documents — rectangular forms shift, break, and recombine. Vector-based pattern scales across any format, balancing concealment and revelation.
Client testimonial: "Working with Beyond was an exceptional experience. Their ability to translate ideas into clean, original work made them feel like an extension of our team." — Brooklyn Earick, Founder
URL: /work/redacted

### Grab&Go — Website (2024)
Tagline: "Open 24 hours every day."
A WebGL coffee cup as key scroll element, illustrated Portuguese city façade housing the store, interactive audio (bicycle click triggers sounds, city birds chirp), playful movable beach footer.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention · CSS Design Awards Special Kudos
Website: grabandgo.pt
URL: /work/grabgo

### Flowcase — Rebranding (2024)
Tagline: "Win bids with stellar resumes."
SaaS resume platform rebranded around the concept of stacks. 'F' symbol merges flow of information with card stack metaphor. 2D-to-3D brand system, social motion graphics, from landing page to dashboard UI.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention
Website: flowcase.com
URL: /work/flowcase

### Jeton — Rebrand & Website (2024)
Tagline: "One wallet for all needs."
Fintech wallet — Official Partner of West Ham United F.C. and Legia Warsaw. Coin-shaped brand symbol, vibrant orange-and-white identity, 3D brand universe with abstract money transaction metaphors.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day
Website: jeton.com
URL: /work/jeton

### Keikku — Branding & Website (2024)
Tagline: "Don't miss a beat."
Smart wireless stethoscope brand centred on sound waves and a whale-shaped waveform. WebGL exploded device view, footer waves that react to sound, on-scroll product narrative.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention · CSS Design Awards Special Kudos
Website: keikku.com
URL: /work/keikku

### Kōzōwood — Website (2023)
Tagline: "Made of Nature."
Zen-like CLT timber homes website. Marimba-led sound design, nature field recordings, WebGL animations, world map wood construction data, drone footage from Comporta, Portugal.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day, Developer Award · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · FWA of the Day
Website: kozowood.com
URL: /work/kozowood

### Talent Protocol — Rebranding (2023)
Tagline: "The web3 professional network."
Web3 professional identity platform. ASCII-figure persona system with custom avatars, token symbols, and ID colour palettes. Interconnected-shapes design system for seamless flow.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention
Website: talentprotocol.com
URL: /work/talent-protocol

### Flecto — Rebranding & Website (2022)
Tagline: "Unlock your rental business."
SaaS rental platform pioneering a "flexible box" container technique — no masks, complex paths generated at render time using GSAP onUpdate. Unified design language from landing page to dashboard.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day, Developer Award · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · FWA of the Day
Website: flecto.io
URL: /work/flecto

### Hematogenix — Rebrand & Website (2022)
Tagline: "Health made simple."
Cancer diagnostics lab. DNA-H spiral mark featured in LogoLounge Trends 2021. 3D visual universe inspired by blood components. Transparent video heroes (up to 4K on Apple Silicon).
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · LogoLounge Trends 2021
Website: hematogenix.com
URL: /work/hematogenix

### Speedy — Branding & Website (2021)
Tagline: "Just like a bank, but better."
Next-gen fintech. Minimal black Swiss-style website, 3D globe that changes colour by country, mobile-first scroll experience with micro-animations.
Awards: Awwwards Site of the Day · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day · FWA of the Day
Website: speedy.com
URL: /work/speedy

### Care to Beauty — Rebrand & Website (2021)
Tagline: "All cosmetics at your Fingertips™."
Europe's leading cosmetics e-commerce. Brand symbol from 'C' fingerprint outlines. Beatrice + New Kansas typography pair. Skin-tone-inspired warm palette. Google-first performance without sacrificing polish.
Awards: Awwwards Honorable Mention, Mobile Excellence · CSS Design Awards Website of the Day
Website: caretobeauty.com
URL: /work/care-to-beauty

## Company

### About Beyond
Beyond is built around one founding partner — Guillaume Hamon — supported by a collective of seasoned creatives, strategists, growth marketers, and technologists. We deliberately avoid the bloated traditional agency model, giving clients direct access to senior global talent with no wasted layers.

**Founding Partner:** Guillaume Hamon
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/guillaumehamon/

**Our belief:** "We've streamlined the outdated and layered agency model to give you direct access to the best global talent. No wasted time, no empty promises. Just impactful results."

### Industries We Serve
- Fintech & Financial Services
- Web3 & Blockchain
- SaaS & Product Companies
- Health & Life Sciences
- Consumer & Retail
- Hospitality & Lifestyle
- Sustainability & Impact

### Partners Program
Beyond runs a curated referral network. Approved partners earn a commission on every client they introduce. Apply at /partners.

## Technical Stack (site)
This site is built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock), Lenis (smooth scroll), and SplitType for text animation.
